'''Klevb''' was a [[Jiivahar]] from [[Carest 1]]. He was made an outcast from his [[talin]] and subsequently left his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. He became a [[Mercenary/Legends|gun-for-hire]].<ref name="SWAJ14" />
